verses.gurmukhi: ੧੪ : ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਯ ਸੁਖਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਉੱਚੇ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਵਿਚ ਹੈ
verses.translit_en: 14 : gursikh i(n)dhray sukhaa(n) to(n) u'che sukh fal vich hai

en.bdb: Gursikh's pleasure fruit transcends sensual pleasures

verses.gurmukhi: ਰੂਪ ਅਨੂਪ ਸਰੂਪ ਲਖ ਹੁਇ ਰੰਗ ਬਿਰੰਗੀ।
verses.translit_en: roop anoop saroop lakh hui ra(n)g bira(n)gee|

en.bdb: Millions of variegated creatures of unparallel beauty are there in this world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਸੰਬਾਦ ਲਖ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਅਭੰਗੀ।
verses.translit_en: raag naadh sa(n)baadh lakh sa(n)gat abha(n)gee|

en.bdb: Likewise millions of vibrations, dialogues and their constant music is there.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੰਧ ਸੁਗੰਧਿ ਮਿਲਾਪ ਲਖ ਅਰਗਜੇ ਅਦੰਗੀ।
verses.translit_en: ga(n)dh suga(n)dh milaap lakh aragaje adha(n)gee|

en.bdb: Mixing many scents millions of pure essences are prepared.

verses.gurmukhi: ਛਤੀਹ ਭੋਜਨ ਪਾਕਸਾਲ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਸੁਢੰਗੀ।
verses.translit_en: chhateeh bhojan paakasaal ras bhog sudda(n)gee|

en.bdb: Similarly in cook houses thirtysix types of delicious dishes are there.
The fully grown up women are there decorated with silken robes and ornaments.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਅਗਮ ਹੈ ਗੁਰੁਸਿਖ ਸਹਲੰਗੀ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal agam hai gurusikh sahala(n)gee ||14||

en.bdb: But association with the gurmukhs is a pleasure fruit which is unapproachable.
